title: A.S.E 2.0: Understanding How Repository Context Impacts the Security of LLM-Generated Code
abstract: arXiv:2611.06294v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) coding assistants and agents construct a repository context before generating code. For security-sensitive code, this context decides whether the model sees the project's safeguards (e.g., authorization checks) or insecure code to imitate. However, context construction is designed almost exclusively for functional correctness, and secure-code benchmarks treat the context as fixed, so how repository context affects the security of generated code remains unclear. We construct CASE-Bench, a benchmark of 145 repository-level tasks from real CVEs in 51 projects. Each task runs in Docker, has functional tests and a proof-of-concept exploit validated in both directions, and is annotated with the repository code that enforces or undermines its security. translated_title: A.S.E 2.0：理解仓库上下文如何影响LLM生成代码的安全性
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）编码助手和智能体在生成代码之前会构建仓库上下文。对于安全敏感的代码，这一上下文决定了模型是能看到项目的安全防护措施（例如授权检查），还是会看到可供模仿的不安全代码。然而，现有的上下文构建几乎完全是为功能正确性设计的，而安全代码基准测试又将上下文视为固定不变，因此仓库上下文如何影响生成代码的安全性仍不明确。我们构建了CASE-Bench，这是一个包含来自51个项目中真实CVE的145个仓库级任务的基准测试。每个任务都在Docker中运行，配有功能测试和经过双向验证的概念验证漏洞利用，并标注了仓库中实施或破坏其安全性的代码。借助CASE-Bench，我们将13种上下文构建方法和六种对照方式与六个LLM进行了比较，对单个上下文元素进行编辑，并分析了编码智能体的运行轨迹。我们……
tldr: 该论文提出CASE-Bench基准测试，基于真实CVE构建145个仓库级任务，首次系统研究了仓库上下文构建方式如何影响LLM生成代码的安全性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces CASE-Bench, a benchmark of 145 repository-level tasks built from real CVEs, to systematically study for the first time how repository context construction impacts the security of LLM-generated code.
